title: Rabbi Yaakov Gevuliya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Challah 3:1 he reports Rabbi Chanina. In Kohelet Rabbah 1:4, Rabbi Levi and Rabbi Yaakov Gevilya report Rabbi Chanina. In Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:2, Rabbi Immi says, “Rabbi Yaakov Gevalya taught before Rabbi Yochanan.”

notes.text: The supplied קימיה is read with the complete Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:2 parallel, קומי, “before.” Gevuliya, Gevilya and Gevalya remain the notice’s different spellings.
